subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. E sits to the immediate right of D. A is an immediate neighbour of B and D. F sits second to the right of D. What is the position of C with respect to D?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

E sits to the immediate right of D.

F sits second to the right of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1be825eb2bf16243d09a50162e8080785ba60e470df504113da333992fd321f7.png] 

A is an immediate neighbour of B and D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/925b5598443ec537a2993793caa92c99c8e1c3796ac99eae7fd694e4608862de.png] 

Then final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/564b016425c424e1f42167833afb387a0f7077b164c2a7f52cea1d3cfae451b5.png] 

So, the position of C with respect to D is **"Third to the left".**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Third to the left".**
